name: Rizuhble's Static Shock Seven
rows: Sell it once you're out of slots.
Pop it before you ult so nobody cancels the storm.
Dying after Enduring Speed? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Opening Rounds.
One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.
Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.
A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.
They hit you with Knockdown, Slowing Hex or Toxic Bullets.
Most of their damage is spirit: Infernus, Kelvin, Geist, Vyper.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
changes: Round 13: new gun build (Kieran: gun Seven around his 3 that turns into ult Seven late) — sources (gun/Power Surge style only): lockbuilds official 'GUN/SPIRIT SEVEN' (Oct 18, from GVS, the top Seven player): lane Monster Rounds, Extra Regen, High-Velocity, Opening Rounds, Extra Spirit, Enchanter's Emblem, Cultist Sacrifice, Duration Extender ('rushing the 4.8k spirit'); mid Surge of Power, Spirit Lifesteal, Mystic Vulnerability, Enduring Speed, Escalating Exposure, Infuser, Toxic Bullets; late Unstoppable ('rush it, you're an easy target every time you ult'), Superior Duration, Spirit Burn, Refresher optional. lockbuilds 'The Thunder Lord Rises Again!' (Sep 30, Power Surge + gun, pivot to Storm Cloud late; 'ALWAYS GET ESCALATING EXPOSURE', Infuser or Spiritual Overflow) and sparkz 'surge+ult seven' (Oct 1, Power Surge and ult, shifting into full ult). Kit: Power Surge procs on every burst shot for 10s (20s at T3) and bounces to 4 enemies, damage 10 + 0.14x and 10 + 0.32x spirit, so Duration Extender and Surge of Power go on it. Order: seemeta's most popular Seven order (59.0% WR, 3,747 games), which maxes Power Surge first.

Round 14: ability order changed to seemeta's current most popular Seven order 3321324143114422 (Oct 5-19, 3,715 games, 59.3% WR; Power Surge first, maxed at point 10): the old order's cited seemeta path is not on the page. Refresher note emptied (restated the card), Witchmail note cut to the sell, Dispel Magic note no longer names Yamato's grapple.
Round 15: Counters description was 121 chars (game limit 112): now 'Get after Toxic Bullets ... Sell Opening Rounds.'

Round 17: desc 'Gun Seven' (was 'Gun Seven into ult'). Gun now comes before spirit, so it's a different build from Ult Seven: Monster Rounds, High-Velocity, Opening Rounds, Cultist = gun 4.8k at 4.8k souls (was spirit first at 7.2k, gun 9.6k); greens next (health 4.8k at 9.6k); then Rapid Rounds into Burst Fire (review's GVS gun core; Power Surge shocks once per burst, so more fire rate = more shocks) before Duration Extender/Surge of Power on Power Surge (spirit 4.8k at 16k), Toxic Bullets after. Ult late: Escalating Exposure, Unstoppable, Infuser, Refresher. Spirit Burn out of the core (13 items with Burst Fire; Toxic Bullets already cuts healing). Counters after Burst Fire.

Round 19: rebuilt as the real public gun/spirit Seven (lockbuilds official GUN/SPIRIT SEVEN by GVS 773087, Oct 19; GVS #1 EU SEVEN 416982, Oct 5): High-Velocity → Opening Rounds and Cultist gun spike, Duration Extender/Surge of Power on Power Surge, Enchanter's, Tesla Bullets (GVS: 'the best item u can buy'), Toxic Bullets, Mystic Vulnerability → Escalating Exposure, Spirit Lifesteal → Spiritual Overflow, Unstoppable, Boundless. Cut the invented Rapid Rounds → Burst Fire line, Superior Duration, Infuser and Refresher (Infuser/Refresher are the ult build's items, so the pair no longer looks the same).
Round 20: Duration Extender now upgrades to Superior Duration (official Gun-Spirit late core) instead of being sold; Spirit Burn sells Opening Rounds; Lightning Scroll added. Total ~77k.

Round 23: kit check. Power Surge shocks once per burst, so fire rate means more shocks. Ricochet (+18% fire rate, bounces apply bullet procs like Tesla Bullets) goes into the late list after Spirit Burn, selling Toxic Bullets, whose anti-heal Spirit Burn's -70% already covers.
Round 25: points reordered for gun-spirit: Power Surge maxed by point 8 (T3 = 20s duration and -15% spirit resist), ball T1 early for farm, Static Charge T1 before ult tiers.
Cost pass: Enchanter's Emblem moved after Cultist Sacrifice (gun 4.8k lands earlier); Improved Spirit added in Mid after Enduring Speed so Boundless Spirit costs 1.6k less.
